name: fault_freeze_frame_entries
evidence: 16 records, not 8. fault_entry_t is 48 bytes and 0x3fe674 + 16 x 48 = 0x3fe974, where system_status_flags_t (fault_detected_bits_0_to_15) starts. Records 0-7 are written by hpcr_setFaultActiveStatus when the fault code of the slot changes (cpp 19218-19254). Records 8-15 (the shadow at 0x3fe7f4: the DAT_003fe7f4 + param_1 * 0x30 stores, cpp 19196-19217) are written on every activation of a fault whose fault_definition_table word has bit 0x10 (cpp 19195). The DM4 freeze frame builder (cpp 24084-24130) indexes both halves as ONE array: fault_entry_t_003fe674[uVar9 * 8 + param_1], uVar9 = 1 when record 8 + param_1 holds a fault code (not 0xaa). cm848_updateFaultEntryCounters writes 0xaa to the fault_code of record uVar2 and to fault_freeze_frame_data_buf[uVar2 * 0x30], which is the fault_code of record 8 + uVar2 (0x3fe7f8 = 0x3fe7f4 + 4). fault_entry_ptr_queue (0x3fed9c) points into records 0-7. The fault_entry_t field rows in structure_definitions.csv stay (they define the type); the 14 label rows inside record 0 and the 0x3fe7f8 byte row go. The name replaces an auto name. Dropping the 1 other named rows turns 3 cpp references into array elements.

name: fault_registered_bits
evidence: Second of three parallel 50-word fault bit arrays, 100 bytes apart: fault_detected_bits (0x3fe974, typed system_status_flags_t), this one (0x3fe9d8) and fault_previous_pass_array (0x3fea3c). Fault n = word n / 16, bit n % 16, faults 0-799 (cm848_processFaultScanGroup walks 0x32 = 50 words of the sibling mask array fault_enable_bitmask_array, cpp 18935). The 69 indexed uses are the heal / clear paths (the sensor channel functions via high_fault_word_index / low_fault_word_index, the misfire monitor, the injector diagnostic, cm848_clearDiagnosticState) clearing the REGISTERED bit with an AND of the inverted single-bit mask for (fault_bit & 0xf), plus cm848_processFaultScanGroup ORing bits in (cpp 18908). So fault_active_status_array is a stale name: wave 2 already calls the other words fault_registered_bits_N_to_M. Word 31 (0x3fea16, hpcr_battery_status_shadow_flags) and word 37 (0x3fea22, j1939_tsc1_mode_shadow) are the registered twins of 0x3fe9b2 / 0x3fe9be in the detected array, so those two names are guesses too. Dropping the 29 other named rows turns 429 cpp references into array elements.

name: sensor_channel_ratiometric_reference_channel_cal
evidence: 128 words (0x3fd948-0x3fda48, the next row sensor_channel_enable_flags is at 0x3fda48), indexed by channel_index. EEPROM-backed (EEPROM 0x4c6, inside the 0x3fd482-0x3feec1 mirror; the old comment says NEVER-WRITTEN ROM), so it takes _cal. Meaning (sensorChannelTypeB_update cpp 58132-58200, the same in the three sibling channel functions): entry 0 = the channel uses its raw reading; otherwise lookup_input = raw x sensor_channel_ratio_scale / sensor_channel_filtered_output[entry] (clamped to 0x3ff, entry guarded below 0x81), i.e. the entry is the number of ANOTHER sensor channel whose filtered value divides this reading (a ratiometric supply reference). EEPROM dump: entry 1 = 28 and entry 3 = 42, the other 126 are 0 (channel 1 = intake manifold pressure, 3 = barometric pressure). The old comment channel to override / QADC type is wrong: the value is not a QADC index. BOOT-USER CHECK (wave 10 build3.log): a ROM-to-RAM thunk sits at RAM 0x3fd994, 4 bytes = entries 38-39 of this table (cm848_forceSupervisorWatchdogReset, ROM 0x7dc4, called by the boot ROM; the application EEPROM mirror overwrites that kernel code). The thunk stage runs after the import, so a global_variables.csv array would be split there, and an arrays.csv array (applied later) would delete the thunk function. Either type word[38] at 0x3fd948 and word[84] at 0x3fd998, or use arrays.csv and add a call override. Nothing else in the proposed ranges is hit.

EEPROM-backed (0x3fda48 is inside the 0x3fd482 mirror, EEPROM 0x5c6), so _cal. Dropping the 2 other named rows turns 3 cpp references into array elements. Boot-user check: no ROM-to-RAM thunk or call override overlaps 0x3fda48-0x3fda58 (wave 10 build3.log).

name: sensor_channel_held_value_enable_bits_cal
evidence: Per-channel bitmap, not a feature flag word (firmware/CLAUDE.md J1939 pedal path: EEPROM 0x5e6, bit n makes channel n output sensor_channel_state_t.held_value; bit 13 = the accelerator pedal channel, which is why fuel demand code tests 0x2000). 15 cpp references use the old name, the scalar ones read word 0. 8 words = 16 bytes up to qadc_channel_index_table at 0x3fda78. Boot-user check: no ROM-to-RAM thunk or call override overlaps 0x3fda68-0x3fda78 (wave 10 build3.log).

text: qadc_channel_index_table (arrays.csv, word[92] at 0x3fda78) is really 128 words, 0x3fda78-0x3fdb78: the sensor channel functions index it with channel_index (0-127) and the next real symbol adc_forced_reading_enable_bits_0_to_15_cal is at 0x3fdb78 = + 0x100. The 92 comes from the copy-window edge rule (0x3fdb30); since wave 9 cut diagnostic_service_dispatch_table to byte[10] (0x3fdb30-0x3fdb3a) only those 10 kernel bytes (words 46-50) still overlap, so the time-shared-RAM check decides. It is EEPROM-backed (EEPROM 0x5f6 and on), so it would also take _cal. The block 0x3fd948-0x3fdb88 is one run of sensor channel configuration: type table 128 words (0x3fd948), enable bits 8 words (0x3fda48), an unnamed 8-word block (0x3fda58, no user found), held value bits 8 words (0x3fda68), QADC index 128 words (0x3fda78), forced reading enable bits 8 words (0x3fdb78). Boot-user check for 0x3fda78-0x3fdb30: no ROM-to-RAM thunk or call override overlaps it (wave 10 build3.log).

The third twin of fault_registered_bits / fault_previous_pass_bits is system_status_flags_t_003fe974 (fault_detected_bits_N_to_M, 100 bytes) - the same word[50] typed as a struct with fields for only some words plus loose rows (hpcr_battery_voltage_flags, iat_sensor_deviation_flags ...). Not proposed: its named words have 1531 direct cpp uses, far more than the indexed uses an array would improve.

Cylinder-indexed arrays not proposed because the count (6 cylinders used, 8 slots by the 16-byte gap) is unproven: cylinder_balance_fueling_trim_cal (word, 0x3fee82), per_cylinder_sync_counter (0x3fb246), per_cylinder_timing_counter (0x3fb256), misfire_monitor_cylinder_attempt_counts (0x40b9ee; its neighbour misfire_monitor_cylinder_response_values is already word[8]). All four have 16 bytes to the next row.

Also looked at and left alone: pci_receive_frame_buffer (0x40b3be, byte, 16 uses, comment says clamped at 20 but the next row is 22 bytes on), pci_transmit_frame_buffer (0x40b442, 12 bytes to the next row), crank_tooth_pattern_table (0x408fc6; the count is the calibration value crank_tooth_pattern_size_cal) and calibration_constant_1 (0x57694, word with index x 5 = 10-byte records, 144 bytes to the next row, not a multiple of 10).

Time-shared RAM: the fault_status_records proposal overlaps boot kernel variables (data_transfer_*, cmf_*, diag_session_state_t, boot_sci_security_state, diag_serial_buffer ...) in slots 77-169. cm848_bootSciCheckSecurityKey and the other boot ROM / kernel functions will print fault_status_records[n] for them after the change; document both roles in the row comment, or use the count-77 variant.

fields.name: fault_slots
fields.evidence: lbzx r12,r4,r6 @ 0x53469c with r4 = 0x5b6e6 + group x 16: one byte per entry, index below 16

evidence: ROM table of 32 monitor groups x 16 slot bytes, 0xaa = empty. cm848_isFaultMonitorGroupComplete (0x534684): lis r11,6 / addi r11,r11,-18714 = 0x5b6e6 @ 0x53468c, slwi r10,r5,4 (group x 16) @ 0x534694, lbzx r12,r4,r6 @ 0x53469c compared with the fault slot, loop bounds cmpwi r6,16 @ 0x5346c8 and cmpwi r5,32 @ 0x5346d8; the same (&DAT_0005b6e6)[slot + group * 0x10] form is used by cm848_isFaultGroupStatusBitSet, diag_mainStateHandler (cpp 80493, 91216) and the monitor-complete pass (cpp 91634-91639). The table ends at 0x5b8e6 where thermostat_monitor_minimum_fuel_to_fail_axis starts (checked). 15 of the 32 groups are all 0xaa, the used slot numbers are at most 160 (valid slots are 0-169). The group number is the bit index tested in diagnostic_monitor_complete_bits. The address has no row in global_variables.csv (it renders DAT_0005b6e6), so nothing to drop. In structure_definitions.csv the fault_slots field is type byte with size 16.
